title: Entrepreneur in Residence(EIR) - GTM
jobDescription:
Context: Why This Role Exists Scaler School of Technology is being built to answer a simple but uncomfortable question: Why does India still not have a globally respected, industry-built engineering university? SST's ambition is not incremental improvement. It is to build a fundamentally better model of engineering

EDUCATION:
Designed with industry, not detached from it Measured by real outcomes, not just credentials Built for students who could go to IITs, BITS, NITs
- but want something better aligned with the real world We are early in this journey. Very early. Today, ~21,000 students apply to SST. Tomorrow, that number needs to cross 1 lakh+ , without diluting quality or trust. This role exists because that leap will not be achieved by marketing alone. It will be achieved by deep insight, honest conversations, rapid iteration, and sharp GTM thinking . What This EIR Role Is (and Is Not) This is not a typical "growth" or "strategy" role. This is not a safe, well-defined execution track. This is an Entrepreneur-in-Residence role inside a high-stakes institution-building journey . As an Ei R, you will: Operate at the frontline of decision-making for India's most serious students and parents Extract first-principles insight from real conversations and convert them into GTM and product decisions Shape how SST communicates, positions, and evolves as an institution Drive and support critical GTM initiatives that move application quality, conversion, and trust Over time, take ownership of launching new programs and initiatives as SST expands Work closely with leadership on institution-building problems with no predefined playbook This role is also deliberately designed for people who want to build something of their own in the future . You will learn how to identify user pain points, test hypotheses, understand P&L & most importantly, learn to make good decisions with incomplete information What You Will Do This is a problem-statement-driven role . Your work will not be defined by a fixed set of responsibilities. It will be defined by the most important problems SST needs solved at any point in time to reach its mission. You will be assigned high-leverage problem statements and given the autonomy to do whatever is required to solve them. Examples of the kinds of problem statements you will own: How do we attract & convert the best student talent? Owning Admissions end-to-end for premium student talent Where exactly does trust get built or lost in a parent's decision journey
- and how do we redesign for it? What narratives, formats, or experiences create clarity instead of confusion at scale? How do we move from 21,000 applications to 1 lakh+ applications without diluting quality or credibility? What new programs, formats, or institutional signals do we need to launch to unlock the next phase of growth? There is no predefined path. You will help create it. What Success Looks Like SST's messaging becomes sharper, calmer, and more credible Parents feel informed, not pressured Leadership decisions are grounded in real insight, not anecdotes The system gets better every cycle because of what you surfaced Who This Role Is For 1-3 years of experience in: Founder's office Strategy or Consulting Early-stage GTM Traits That Matter More Than a Resume Exceptional at problem-solving Ability to structure thinking live, in conversations Passionate about improving communication skills Intellectual honesty. You can say "this doesn't make sense" when it doesn't Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete information High personal standards, discipline, and follow-through Coachable, but not passive If you need tight briefs, fixed playbooks, or predictable outcomes, this role will feel uncomfortable. Growth Trajectory This Ei R role is a launchpad , not a terminal position. For founders-in-the-making, this role offers a rare apprenticeship: Exposure to zero-to-one institution building , not just execution Direct visibility into how large, complex bets are evaluated and sequenced Pattern recognition across hundreds of high-stakes decisions made by families, students, and leaders Strong performers can grow into: Institution-building roles across GTM, Experience, or New Initiatives Expanded mandates as SST & Scaler scales nationally and globally Why Join Us? You will work on a problem that actually matters to India You will be exposed to real leadership decisions early You will learn faster than in most "safe" roles You will help build something that did not exist before As an Ei R, you will operate inside SST's trusted leadership circle. This includes regular interaction, reviews, and problem-solving with leaders who have built and scaled at Meta, Mc Kinsey, etc This is Day 0 energy. It will be intense. It will be demanding. It will also be deeply rewarding if you care about education done right. Application Process Short note explaining your background, why this role, why now with Resume to: Hiring Manager : manmeet@scaler.com People Team : tanya.pandey@scaler.com Process Round 1: Role & mindset fit Round 2: Scenario-based problem solving Round 3: Culture & ownership alignment Timeline: ~2 weeks end-to-end. Final Note If you want a polished title, this is not it. If you want to be part of building a new model of education in India, this might be. Apply only if that excites you. About Scaler School of Technology School of Technology (SST) is a 4-year, full-time residential undergraduate program in Computer Science & AI. With a sub-4% acceptance rate, SST is building India's Ivy League for tech
- where elite engineering meets real-world outcomes, mentorship, and hands-on experience In just its second year, over 21,000+ students applied for only a few hundred seats, with many leaving offers from NITs and BITS to join SST. The campus today is home to a handpicked cohort of students who are not only academically outstanding but also driven to build startups, publish research, and compete in global contests. The environment is intentionally designed to mirror the world's best technical universities
- selective intake, high-calibre peer group, and access to industry leaders. Please watch this video to learn more : link About Scaler Launched in 2019, Scaler is India's leading tech education company that upskills working professionals and educates aspiring engineering students. Scaler's industry-vetted curriculum addresses real-world challenges through two flagship online programs: Scaler and Scaler DSML. To further redefine education, Scaler has launched: Scaler Neovarsity : An outcome-focused online Master's Programme Scaler School of Technology (SST) : A 4-year residential UG program in Computer Science Scaler School of Business : An 18-month PGP in Management & Technology Our parent firm, Interview Bit, has been featured in the Financial Times' Asia-Pacific High Growth Companies 2021-2025. Scaler is backed by marquee global investors like Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Tiger Global, and Lightrock India.

title: Performance & Brand Art Director
jobDescription:
Reporting to: Group Head, Design (On-Site) Team Size/Individual Contributor: Small creative team (2-4 designers) About Scaler Launched in 2019, Scaler is India's leading tech education company that upskills working professionals and educates aspiring engineering students. Scaler's industry-vetted curriculum addresses real-world challenges through two flagship online programs: Scaler and Scaler DSML. To further redefine education, Scaler has launched: Scaler Neovarsity : An outcome-focused online Master's Programme Scaler School of Technology (SST) : A 4-year residential UG program in Computer Science Scaler School of Business : An 18-month PGP in Management & Technology Our parent firm, Interview Bit, has been featured in the Financial Times' Asia-Pacific High Growth Companies 2021-2025. Scaler is backed by marquee global investors like Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Tiger Global, and Lightrock India. About the Role The Brand & Performance Art Director is responsible for elevating Scaler's visual narrative across marketing, paid media, and brand-led campaigns. This role exists to translate business and consumer insights into powerful, high-performing creative outcomes. You will drive concept development, mentor designers, and craft visual stories that strengthen the brand and deliver measurable impact. What you will do/Responsibilities Translate business, product, and marketing briefs into high-quality creative concepts and campaigns. Create and oversee visual outputs across static, motion, video, and digital ad formats. Collaborate with copywriters, marketing managers, and brand teams to build integrated campaigns. Mentor, guide, and review work of junior designers to maintain high creative standards. Develop and maintain a consistent visual language aligned with brand strategy. Adapt concepts to multiple digital distribution channels for performance marketing. Create audience-first storytelling that increases engagement, recall, and conversions. Maintain an organized repository of assets and promote design best practices within the team. Growth Opportunities This role can grow into Senior Art Director, Creative Lead, or Brand Creative Manager roles. You will have the opportunity to lead larger campaign mandates, co-own brand systems, and influence creative strategy across the organization. Required Qualifications (Max 5-6) 3-5 years of experience in art direction, brand design, or performance design in a startup, creative agency, or digital-first environment. Strong mastery of visual design, illustration, motion graphics, and storytelling. Hands-on experience with Adobe Suite, Figma, animation tools, and AI-assisted creative workflows. Ability to think from consumer insight to creative execution with demonstrated portfolio impact. Experience mentoring designers and working cross-functionally in fast-paced environments. Strong attention to detail, process excellence, and ability to deliver high-quality output under tight timelines. Application Process Our hiring process is designed to evaluate creative thinking, craft excellence, and collaborative mindset while ensuring a smooth and transparent experience for every candidate. We aim to close the hiring process within 2 weeks. Round 1
- Virtual Round with Group Head (Design) Round 2
- Creative Assignment Round 3
- Interview Round with Associate Creative Director(Design) Round 4
- Final Interview Round with the Creative Director Why Scaler Empowering

ROLE:
Work at the intersection of brand, community, and experience Inspiring Team : Built by leaders from Meta, Google, Mc Kinsey & Amazon Culture of Meritocracy : High ownership, fast growth, and real impact Perks : Free food, health insurance, and a world-class office environment APPLY NOW!

title: Social Media Manager
jobDescription:
Reporting to: Content and Brand Head, SST (On-Site) Team Size/Individual Contributor: Individual contributor About Scaler Launched in 2019, Scaler is India's leading tech education company that upskills working professionals and educates aspiring engineering students. Scaler's industry-vetted curriculum addresses real-world challenges through two flagship online programs: Scaler and Scaler DSML. To further redefine education, Scaler has launched: Scaler Neovarsity : An outcome-focused online Master's Programme Scaler School of Technology (SST) : A 4-year residential UG program in Computer Science Scaler School of Business : An 18-month PGP in Management & Technology Our parent firm, Interview Bit, has been featured in the Financial Times' Asia-Pacific High Growth Companies 2021-2025. Scaler is backed by marquee global investors like Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), Tiger Global, and Lightrock India. About the Role We are seeking a Social Media Manager who will be the on-ground driver of SST's brand presence. This is a highly dynamic and hands-on role that combines social media execution, analytics, and student engagement. From covering campus fests and Supermentor sessions to publishing daily Stories, Reels, and Shorts, you will ensure that the SST experience is visible, engaging, and inspiring to the outside world, while also tracking and maintaining all published content across platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is a true social media native, highly energetic, detail-oriented, and strong with analytics, with the ability to track performance, draw insights, and continuously optimize content for better reach and engagement. What you will do/Responsibilities Lead Campus Coverage Coordinate with production and media teams to capture key campus moments from fests, Supermentor sessions, DJ nights, to club activities and personally cover events when required Instagram Engagement Manage daily Stories, Highlights, and Reels in alignment with brand guidelines You Tube Shorts Repurpose long form content and create engaging Shorts to maximize reach and discovery Content Publishing Ensure consistent and timely uploads across You Tube, Instagram, Linked In, and Facebook Trending Content Identify and execute relevant trending formats such as Robo Dog style reels aligned with SST's brand voice Editor and Agency Coordination Work closely with agencies and freelance editors to ensure timely delivery, quality control, service fulfillment, and proper data management Community Engagement Respond to comments and DMs across all owned social platforms to maintain high engagement Outbound ORM Proactively engage via comments and DMs on relevant brands and influencers platforms to increase visibility and engagement Tracking and Reporting Track all live content, maintain performance dashboards, share visibility updates, and highlight key wins Video Packaging Ensure thumbnails for long form and short form videos are optimized and repackage older content to improve views and performance Cross POD Support Provide support across all Content PODs as required Growth Opportunities Fast-track growth to Content Marketing Manager / Social Media Lead roles. High-performance culture with opportunities for rapid career progression within Scaler. Required Qualifications 1-3 years of experience in social media/content execution , preferably in youth, campus, or event-driven brands. Strong in analysing social media analytics across platforms such as Meta Business Suite, You Tube Studio, and Linked In Analytics, with the ability to interpret data, track performance trends, and derive actionable insights. A natural content creator
- someone who lives and breathes Instagram, You Tube, and reels. Strong understanding of short-form content trends and ability to adapt them for SST's context. Hands-on skills : basic video editing, shooting (phone/camera), and real-time content packaging. High energy, willingness to hustle, and ability to juggle multiple events/projects simultaneously. Excellent coordination skills
- comfortable working with student clubs, freelancers, and agencies. Mission-driven: excited to build SST as India's Ivy League of tech . Application Process Round 1
- Fitment & Role Understanding Round 2
- Assignment Round Final Round
- Cultural & Team Fitment Why Scaler Empowering

ROLE:
Work at the intersection of brand, community, and experience Inspiring Team : Built by leaders from Meta, Google, Mc Kinsey & Amazon Culture of Meritocracy : High ownership, fast growth, and real impact Perks : Free food, health insurance, and a world-class office environment APPLY NOW!

title: Tax Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Tax Manager Location: Bangalore About Scaler Launched in 2019, Scaler is India's leading upskilling platform. Our industry vetted curriculum provides solutions to real world challenges and addresses the changing dynamics of industry through two flagship online programs: Scaler Academy (Software Development) and Scaler DSML (Data Science and Machine Learning). To further build on this, we launched Neovarsity
- an online university that offers an outcome-focused Master's Program accredited with ECTS. We also run 2 on-campus programs
- Scaler School of Technology (SST) , an offline UG program in Computer Science , and Scaler School of Business (SSB) , an offline PGP in Management and Technology. Our parent firm, Interview Bit, is featured on the Financial Times Asia Pacific High Growth Companies 2021, 2022 and 2023 ranking. Valued at $710 million, Scaler is backed by marquee global investors like Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Tiger Global, and Lightrock India. It has expanded its footprints across India and the US.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Ensure Compliance: Continuously monitor and ensure strict adherence to all relevant requirements under applicable tax regulations, both domestic and international. Review & Supervise Tax Filings: Oversee the preparation and review of all Direct and Indirect Tax filings (e.g., GST, Income Tax, Transfer Pricing) to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant submissions. Collaborate for Tax Efficiency: Work closely with the finance team to ensure tax-efficient structures in transactions, accurate reconciliations, and the timely recognition of tax provisions. Audit & Internal Controls Oversight : Regularly monitor internal controls and audit mechanisms to proactively identify and address any gaps or discrepancies in tax compliance. Proactive Risk Management: Implement robust systems and procedures to uphold tax compliance, with a focus on mitigating risks and addressing potential tax-related challenges in a proactive manner. Audit & Data Preparation: Facilitate the preparation and communication of relevant tax-related data for both internal and statutory audits, including specialized audits such as GST Audits and Tax Audits. Expert Collaboration : Collaborate with both internal and external tax experts to obtain advice and recommendations on major tax efficiency issues and complex tax matters. Primary Tax Contact: Act as the central point of contact for all tax-related queries within the company, providing guidance and expertise on compliance matters. Good to Have: Strong understanding of Indian Tax Laws Prior experience in a multi entity, multi geography set up Skills: Good knowledge of accounting software Tally , Reconciliations of revenues. Strong in Excel and Google Sheets Excellent communication and project management skills for working with external experts and internal teams. title: Program Manager/Sr. Program Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Program Manager / Sr. Program Manager Location : Electronic City, Bangalore Reporting to : VP, Head of Operations About Scaler Launched in 2019, Scaler is India's leading tech education company that upskills working professionals and educates aspiring engineering students. Scaler's industry-vetted curriculum provides solutions to real-world challenges, addressing the changing dynamics of the technology industry through three flagship programs: Scaler Academy, Scaler Devops and Scaler DSML. Scaler believes in creating real-life impact by focusing on ‘impact-driven' tech talent. Enrolled learners are mentored and taught by leaders and subject-matter experts working with leading organisations, including MAANG companies. Scaler has generated enviable career outcomes in a short period, and on average, its learners see a 4.5x Ro I (return on investment) and a salary hike of approximately 126%. To further redefine tech education, Scaler has launched Scaler Neovarsity
- an online university that offers an outcome-focused Master's Programme accredited with ECTS and Scaler School of Technology
- a 4-year residential UG program in Computer Science. Scaler Enterprise is its B2B arm that focuses on building relationships with domestic and global organisations to provide them with industry-ready talent. Over 900 companies have worked with Scaler for their tech recruitment needs. The startup's parent firm, Interview Bit, is featured on the Financial Times's Asia Pacific High Growth Companies 2021, 2022 and 2023 rankings. Valued at $710 million, Scaler is backed by marquee global investors like Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Tiger Global, and Lightrock India. It has expanded its footprint across India and the US. About the team The Scaler Business Operations team ensures high-quality learning experiences and that the right career outcomes are provided to learners as part of the Scaler online vertical. This means managing and optimising the day-to-day activities and processes of the functions that the team oversees: onboarding, participation, experience, and placement. This team plays a critical role in achieving the company's strategic goals and objectives through effective internal and external coordination with the learners and execution of mission-critical problem statements. Role & Responsibilities of a PM/Sr. PM Problem-Solving & Collaboration Proactively identify and resolve operational challenges to ensure smooth execution. Conduct pre- and post-mortems to troubleshoot issues and implement damage control as needed. Work cross-functionally with instructors, product teams, and support teams to drive program success. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal formats across teams and leadership. Execution & Operations Take end-to-end ownership of stakeholder management, including onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, payments, and deboarding. Develop, execute, and maintain detailed operational plans to ensure seamless program execution. Track and manage daily, weekly, and monthly tasks with precision and timeliness. Ensure high-quality, error-free deliverables that exceed team standards. Monitor and report workstream progress to support strategic decision-making. Draft policies and document processes to enhance efficiency and standardisation. Leverage internal tools (e.g., Google Sheets, Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools) for data-driven decision-making. Identify and implement process automation and optimisation strategies. Independently manage and scale multiple workstreams simultaneously. Team Collaboration & Contribution Work closely with peers to drive collective team success and operational excellence. Leading a team of passionate associates and empowering them to deliver meaningful impact across key business functions. Qualifications Strong passion for education, technology, and working in a dynamic startup environment A background in tech or experience in ed-tech operations is preferred Prior experience in stakeholder/ vendor management High proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, Word, and data visualisation tools Excellent problem-solving and communication abilities Proactive, self-driven, and action-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability over multiple workstreams
